purpose: Sections that open and close, built on native <details> and <summary>, with single or multiple expansion.

supplied: native <details>/<summary> semantics, so it works before JavaScript loads and is findable by in-page search
Enter and Space toggle the summary, which is focusable by default
the open state is a real DOM attribute rather than a class
required: summary text that says what is inside, since a collapsed section is judged entirely by its heading
`multiple` where sections are independent — forcing one open at a time hides content a user was reading

composition.notes: Items come from children or the `items` array, not both.

safeMutations.rationale: Appearance is safe; which section is open is state, and `items` is the content.

propNotes.collapsible: Whether the last open section can be closed, leaving none open.
